name: Robot Simulator (example)
description: An example simulator: a robot with momentum chasing the plan, limited by traction and reaction time. Pick it from the Sim menu by the playback controls to see a ghost robot and how far it strays.
author: Turtle Tracer

settings.label: Responsiveness
settings.help: How hard the robot corrects towards where it should be (per second).

settings.label: Damping
settings.help: 1 settles without overshooting; lower values swing past.

settings.label: Traction
settings.help: The share of the robot's maximum acceleration the wheels can actually use.
